gloss: dismissal from a post; removal from office

definitions.gloss: dismissal from a post; removal from office
definitions.explanation: The act of removing someone from their official position, especially in government or public service. A formal, often disciplinary action.

examples.japanese: {不祥事|ふしょうじ}で{免職|めんしょく}になった。
examples.english: He was dismissed from his post due to a scandal.

examples.japanese: {懲戒|ちょうかい}{免職|めんしょく}の{処分|しょぶん}が{下|くだ}された。
examples.english: A disciplinary dismissal was handed down.

examples.japanese: {公務員|こうむいん}が{職務|しょくむ}{怠慢|たいまん}で{免職|めんしょく}される{事例|じれい}は{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: Cases of civil servants being dismissed for neglect of duty are not uncommon.

notes: Primarily used for public officials and civil servants. The most severe form is {懲戒|ちょうかい}{免職|めんしょく} (disciplinary dismissal), which differs from {諭旨|ゆし}{免職|めんしょく} (resignation under advisement, a less severe form). For private-sector employees, {解雇|かいこ} (firing/dismissal) is more common. Compare also {罷免|ひめん} (removal from office, used for high-ranking officials).
